title: Day 5 of AI/Algo Trading (Paper) - Posting for accountability
author: Enzobevmax

comments.author: pigeon_shit
comments.body: Respect for posting every day, red days included. Question since you're on paper: how are you planning to check that the paper fills match what you'd actually get live? That gap is the thing I've struggled with most in my own bots, and I'd like to hear how you're handling it before you switch to real money.

replies.author: Enzobevmax
replies.body:
Yes. Too much fakery on here so if I make some great progress, I want it validated.

Every backtest and paper result already pays extra slippage built in to simulate live fills, more on stop exits. Live entries skip wide spreads and stale quotes. The real test is the first live phase: a small cash account running the same signals alongside paper, comparing each fill side by side. We only scale up once live matches paper over enough sessions.

replies.author: pigeon_shit
replies.body: Running live and paper side by side and comparing each fill is a solid plan. When you say you'd want it validated, what would you actually trust? A broker statement, a third party tracking it from day one, something else?
